mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.5 million does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -1% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a tightening monetary policy with slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with slowing growth
failure_condition: If the joint condition of FEDFUNDS > 0.25% and GDPC1 < 0% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.
